The '''Mephout Dominion''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Mephout system/Legends|Mephout system]], home to the [[Mephout]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders carried out an [[Attack on the Mephout system|attack]] on the government of the Mephout Dominion.

==Description==
The Mephout Dominion was an isolated<ref name="Journal11" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located on the edge of the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Journal11" /> It contained the [[Mephout system/Legends|Mephout system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mephout]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Journal11" />

==History==
[[File:NagaiKodaVirgilliaMephout-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|In 4 ABY, the Nagai attacked the Mephout Dominion.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Mephout [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Until the Mephout Dominion was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], nearly all translating duties in the sector were carried out by the Mephout-designed [[RST Model Translator Droid]]s. However, due to the [[Translator droid/Legends|droids']] high susceptibility to [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulses]], which tended to interfere with their rationality circuits, the [[Droid/Legends|units]] caused numerous problems during important government functions, leading to the issuance of a [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] proposal and half a dozen declarations of war as well as a dozen [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] being carried out.<ref name="Journal11" />

As part of their [[Nagai–Tof War|incursions]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders successfully [[Attack on the Mephout system|assaulted]] the Mephout system<ref name="TEA" /> as part of an attack on the Mephout Dominion's government, which at that point had not yet officially aligned itself with the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].<ref name="ForgottenWar">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mephout Dominion was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' statistics included with the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[Bungo n' Rusti Get Carry-Out]]," which was authored by [[James Anderson|Jim Anderson]] and published in the [[November]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Journal11" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Mephout system in grid square H-20.<ref name="TEA Mephout" />
